name: @mstar-harness/omp
description: Morning Star harness omp (Oh My Pi) plugin — engine-backed runtime gates (status/dispatch/lease) + mstar-* skills, commands, and agents for omp.

scripts.build: bun run bundle-assets && rm -rf dist hooks tools extensions && bun build src/hooks/pre/mstar-gates.ts --target node --outfile dist/hooks/pre/mstar-gates.js && bun build src/extensions/model-handoff.ts --target node --external '@oh-my-pi/*' --outfile dist/extensions/model-handoff.js && bun build src/extensions/phase2-orchestration.ts --target node --external '@oh-my-pi/*' --outfile dist/extensions/phase2-orchestration.js && bun build src/extensions/mcp-identity.ts --target node --external '@oh-my-pi/*' --outfile dist/extensions/mcp-identity.js && bunx tsc && cp -R dist/hooks hooks && cp -R dist/extensions extensions

omp.name: morning-star-harness
omp.description: Morning Star multi-agent harness skills and iteration commands for omp.

modelHandoff.description: When enabled, each new Morning Star iteration arms @slow once the direction is locked and before the Phase 1 draft is written, then switches this coordinator session to handoffTarget after Phase 1 fully completes. Off by default.

handoffTarget.description: Coordinator model after a completed Phase 1. Used only when modelHandoff is enabled.

phase2PlanInstances.description: Allow Phase-2 coordinators to launch additional plan-scoped primary sessions up to maxPlanInstances. Off by default; native background tasks and bounded scheduling reminders are independent.

maxPlanInstances.description: Maximum concurrently active plan-scoped primary sessions (owned pending launches included; iteration coordinator and task subagents excluded). Lowering it stops new launches without killing active work.
